verdict.rationale: Angular's own CLI documents a command that "Configures the gathering of Angular CLI usage metrics," so the product itself offers a control over usage tracking. The evidence is a single one-line description and never explicitly says metrics can be disabled. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an opt-out/disable option, scope of what telemetry is collected, environment-variable or CI opt-out, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Configures the gathering of Angular CLI usage metrics.
